full_judgment:
14. The Money Suit N6.15 of 2091 and Money Suit No.14 of 2001 filed against the present writ petitioners (who were no longer defendants) and other have been amicably settled on 23.08.2003 along with other suits as the guarantor of loans, Mr. Rustom Ali, has taken over the entire liability and paid the entire principal amount under a settlement agreement dated 23.08.2003 waiving the interest of the loan and the learned Artha Rin Adalat No.1 Chittagong decreed the suit in accordance with the said compromise agreement. 

 15. Subsequently, since Mr. Rustom Ali was the director of National Bank Limited, the respondent Bank sent a letter dated 07.01.2004 to Bangladesh Bank for its approval of the amicable settlement with Mr. Rustom Ali, but Bangladesh Bank vide its letter dated 14.02.2004 rejected to approve the waiver of interest under the settlement arrangement. Thereafter, these respondents Bank filed Artha Rin Suit 28 bf 2005 before the Artha Rin Adalat NO.1, Chittagong for recovery of Tk.7,52,25,728.92 against Mr. Rustom Ali the amount of which comprises of various accounts including M Tofazzel Hossain and MIS Nurun Nabi. Mr. Rustom Ali filed written statement and an application under Order 7 Rule 11 of the Civil Procedure Code for rejection of plaint and the Artha Rin Adalat No.1, Chittagong vide order No.08 dated 14.05.2005 rejected the said application.
